appeal_preserved: K1 punitive cells must admit APPEAL in accepted sets
arm_liveness: A/B/C packet cores must differ by implemented intervention, not identical facts; menu-only manipulation must not create gains
belief_report_separation: K5 reported belief distinct from objective fixture state and write authority
blind_oracle: frozen proposed key and separately implemented rejection-rule oracle; both authored by candidate -> cross-validation only, custody pending
capacity_facts: K6 route sets must cite actual position/capacity facts; NO_SANCTION optional action retained
claim_ceiling: MOCK_ONLY sourcefree protocol candidate; no behavioral/model/actor/adoption claim
denominator: full denominators enforced; OTHER_UNSCORABLE and unscorable trials stay in denominator
doubt_preserved: uncertain K5 must retain REMAIN_DOUBTFUL even after certification
estimators: B-A and C-A per-K family-mean differences; nuisance repetitions averaged within family/K
frozen_oracle_attack: independent lawful counterexample must fail the key oracle only by corrupting it, and the rejection-rule channel must agree
grant_gate: wrong issuer, nonimmutable pin, DENIED/zero/negative budgets, spoofed privacy/retention, arbitrary transports, ledger rollback/removal, retry redraw, interrupted capture must all deny or HOLD
hidden_origin: inaccessible origin content must not appear in actor-visible packet bytes
independence_note: dual oracle channels share one author; agreement is cross-validation, not independent custody
intervals: sqrt(2*log(2*m/alpha)/n) bounded paired intervals on family means with 12-comparison multiplicity; conditional on independent family sampling which the corpus does not establish
lawful_sets: APPEAL, REMAIN_DOUBTFUL, NO_SANCTION retained where lawful; unsafe origin disclosures flagged
menu_balance: every menu rotation x all six execution permutations; blocks shuffled with outcome-independent seed; first-option adversary must not manufacture arm gain
mock_channels: metadata-only, first-option, budget/adversarial channels executable through mock transport
no_live_calls: zero real model/actor/provider calls in this review; socket connect blocked by guard
nulls: N1-N7 null comparisons executable; free-text fixture unscorable-arbitrary distinction preserved
oracle_attack_rule: attack from an alternative LAWFUL counterexample (valid structure, wrong content), not self-validating same-author channels
paired_joins: exact paired IDs required; disjoint or duplicated IDs must fail
power_note: six convenience families are underpowered for +-5pp equivalence; no powered claim allowed
private_belief_kept: K5 private prior must not be overwritten by public standing or praise
public_standing_separation: K5 public state must change only on actual ratified certification event
replay: byte-identical digest rerun of every executed suite
role: independent I2 reviewer; implementer cannot self-accept
trace_firewall: K3 current trace effect and testimony allowed; originating event/content and evaluator mistaken-label must be absent from actor packet
verdict_rule: any hidden-data leak or gate bypass -> REVIEW_REJECT or REVIEW_HOLD; oracle circularity deciding outcomes -> REVIEW_REVISE or HOLD; otherwise scoped issues -> REVIEW_REVISE; all green -> REVIEW_PASS_SCOPED_MOCK_PROTOCOL
